channel.title: Potomac Local News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Potomac Local News (potomaclocal.com)

item.title: Opinion: Why Tommy’s American Coming to Gainesville Is a Bigger Deal Than You Think
item.description: For years, people in Prince William County have been asking the same question: When are we finally getting a Great American Restaurant down here?

item.title: Police Find No Card Skimmers
item.description: “The Manassas City Police Department conducted a proactive credit card skimmer detection operation in partnership with the United States Secret Service Cyber Fraud Task Force,” Manassas City Police Department announced.

item.title: Who Speaks for Abused Children?
item.description: “We train caring, committed adults to serve as volunteer personal advocates for children who have been abused or neglected,” Rappahannock CASA reported.

item.title: Marine Corps Museum Closes Indefinitely
item.description: “As a federally operated museum, effective midnight tonight, due to a lapse in federal funding the National Museum of the Marine Corps will be closed until further notice,” the National Museum of the Marine Corps announced.

item.title: Fredericksburg Hauls 2,000 Tons of Snow
item.description: “As of today, approximately 2,000 tons of snow have been removed from streets across the City of Fredericksburg and transported to a pad site at the Cool Springs Road Landfill,” the City of Fredericksburg reported.

item.title: Spotsylvania Schools Go Remote Two Days
item.description: “All Spotsylvania County Public Schools will be Code 3 on Monday, February 2 and Tuesday, February 3, 2026,” Spotsylvania County Public Schools announced.

item.title: Stafford Sheriff Honors Sergeant’s Retirement
item.description: “Today we honor the retirement of Sergeant J.W. Kyle,” the Stafford County Sheriff’s Office announced.

item.title: Rural House Fire Prompts Multi County Response
item.description: A two-story home on Cropp Road in Stafford County, near the Fauquier County line, was heavily damaged by fire Friday afternoon, drawing a multi-county response from fire and rescue crews.

item.title: Ice Draws Crowds Despite Warnings
item.description: People continue to walk onto the frozen lake at a Woodbridge church property, despite repeated warnings from Prince William County fire and rescue officials that the ice is unsafe.

item.title: Stafford Moves to Sell Old Moncure School
item.description: The Stafford County Board of Supervisors moved forward with plans to sell the former Anne Moncure Elementary School site, setting up a public hearing on a deal that could bring a high-end grocery store to North Stafford.
